scope_label: IPSAS-oriented accounting quality and reporting exception review
knowledge_status: synthetic design baseline; organization-approved policy and requirement library not yet connected
implementation_assumption: Manual PDF/Excel intake may be used during a controlled pilot. SharePoint, email, ledger, reconciliation and reporting-system integrations require later owner-approved design, security and data contracts.
standards_note: No IPSAS edition, paragraph or accounting treatment is encoded as an authoritative requirement. Production content must be selected, licensed where applicable, versioned and approved by qualified accounting owners.
